chapter_title_en: The Massacre of a False Front
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 596: Ji Ning's Calculated Massacre Against the Seamless Gate
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning launches a devastatingly efficient attack on the Seamless Gate, systemically erasing the Celestial Immortal Shaoyan Chou from existence. But his act of a mad avenger fools his enemies completely.
og_title: Desolate Era 596 - The Massacre of a False Front
og_description: Ji Ning's revenge begins. He wipes out an outpost and all of its commander's hidden clones, misdirecting the Seamless Gate's leadership into thinking he is nothing but a lucky madman.
twitter_description: Ji Ning wipes out a Seamless Gate outpost and all of its commander's hidden clones, expertly playing the fool to fool the confident, arrogant leaders of the enemy.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme treasure born from the primordial chaos. It possesses a spirit and can evolve, changing form according to its master's will. Usually leagues above manufactured magic treasures.

An incredibly advanced cultivation stage far beyond a normal Celestial Immortal. Having "almost Pure Yang" strength means a cultivator is an extreme anomaly, capable of slaughtering ordinary Celestial Immortals with ease.

The power of the Heaven Stargold Beads to condense into a "World" (a Heaven) within its banner form. A single Banner of the Heavens carries the force of an entire small world, explaining its devastating power.
The unique execution method of the Heaven Stargold Beads. It creates two massive grinding discs that crush all matter and energy within the treasure’s internal space, used to kill captured enemies.
The nickname of Shaoyan Chou's main body, indicating his status and power within the Seamless Gate.
